data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to get location updates in the background for Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides background location tracking using CoreLocation on iOS and FusedLocationProvider on Android. It exposes location updates containing latitude, longitude, altitude, bearing, accuracy, speed, time, and mock status.
use_when: You need to continuously track user location even when the app is running in the background.
Targeting both Android and iOS with native location services.
avoid_when: You only need foreground location updates.
You want a fully managed reactive stream library without manual service start and stop commands.
strengths: Supports background execution on both Android and iOS.
Allows configuration of distance filters and time intervals.
Supports custom Android notification settings for foreground services.
weaknesses: Requires manual platform configuration and permission declarations.
Known issue where starting the service multiple times causes duplicate callbacks unless explicitly stopped.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding location permissions and background modes to iOS Info.plist and Android Manifest.xml.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: More actively maintained cross-platform location plugin with robust permission handling and extensive configuration options.
